title: Stable core fields, flexible labels
rule: Use core capability and modality for broad behavior only; use label records and dimension records for vertical, jurisdiction, workflow, buyer, deployment, and risk specificity.
review_rule: Curator approval is required before generated labels affect deployment routing.

title: Trades label family
promotion_rule: Generated trade labels remain candidates until matched to a procedure, code source, or reviewed checklist.

title: Oil and gas label family
promotion_rule: High-risk labels require source governance and human review before routing.

title: Animal hospital label family
promotion_rule: Clinical or medication-related labels require expert review before deployment.

title: Jurisdiction label family
promotion_rule: Jurisdiction labels should link to a canonical place or agency entity when available.

title: Model-generated dimension rule
rule: Low-cost models may propose dimensions such as complexity, deployment frequency, review risk, and out-of-box LLM weakness, but generated dimensions must carry confidence, model route, provenance, and review status.
promotion_rule: Only reviewed or benchmark-supported dimensions should affect pricing, deployment, or safety gates.
